summary: Associate Director, Financial Services candidate with ~7 years in quantitative risk analysis, fixed income and derivatives analytics, and bank balance-sheet risk for institutional portfolios. Delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs ($5–25bn per engagement); client-facing delivery to pension funds, asset managers, and insurers, with committee presentation experience. Deep grounding in capital, liquidity, and interest-rate risk frameworks; financial statement analysis and accounting concepts through CFA and IFRS 17/9 delivery. Python and Excel in daily production use.

sections.heading: Quantitative Modeling & Fixed Income Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of client assets.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation for fixed income and cross-asset mandates — review curve construction, credit-spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; escalate outputs lacking economic defensibility.

sections.heading: Capital, Liquidity & Balance-Sheet Risk Analysis
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — forward-looking liquidity risk and balance-sheet visibility across long-dated horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity-gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding and refinancing analysis for institutional mandates.
Oversaw interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee capital frameworks.

sections.heading: Surveillance, Committees & Communication
bullets: Perform ongoing surveillance-style review of client portfolio analytics — monitor model performance, investigate anomalies, and prepare committee-ready risk commentary for senior stakeholders in client-facing settings.

Member of the model governance committee — methodology review and challenge, documentation and benchmarking standards; built Python analytics pipelines with embedded validation controls, in production across the modelling team.

Led onboarding and implementation of PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM vendor risk platforms for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms — client-facing requirements scoping and post-deployment validation.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — applied financial statement analysis and accounting concepts to align liability measurement and reporting frameworks with system implementation.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and risk management functions on governance documentation, model controls, and regulatory readiness across complex insurer balance sheets.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed environments.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR; conducted risk decomposition and contribution-to-risk analysis across funds and portfolios.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk alongside all major investment-product types.

Presented quantitative findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients; led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger, developing and validating the model evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
